Images inside the reading views
==============================

The seven published book covers were downloaded from Penguin Random House's cover service. Each is an existing edition cover, displayed without cropping or overlaid text. Copyright remains with the respective rights holders. Edition details and clickable publisher credits are in `../../book-images.js`.

Cover download URL pattern: `https://images.penguinrandomhouse.com/cover/{ISBN}?width=480`.

`whirlwind.jpg` is William Blake's *The Lord Answering Job out of the Whirlwind* (1825), from the Rosenwald Collection, National Gallery of Art, accession 1943.3.1815. The museum identifies the image as public domain. The Wikimedia Commons reproduction is CC0:

- Museum: https://www.nga.gov/artworks/4973-lord-answering-job-out-whirlwind
- Image and CC0 record: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:William_Blake,_The_Lord_Answering_Job_out_of_the_Whirlwind,_1825,_NGA_4973.jpg

The portfolio's “Voice from the Whirlwind” analysis concerns Job 38–42, so this is an illustration of that passage rather than a cover claiming it is a separate publication.
